name: Plausible Analytics
_why: One switch. `enabled` gates the script tag, the Content-Security-Policy hosts
and which variant of every claim about tracking the site prints, in all four
languages. Nothing says the site counts visitors until the counting is real,
and nothing claims the site counts nobody once it does.
`enabled` stays false until a real site is created in the Plausible account.
`siteToken` is the domain Plausible registers the site under, which is the
value of its script's data-domain attribute, normally victoriaswart.com.
The build refuses to publish with `enabled` true and `siteToken` empty.
Chosen over Google Analytics because it sets no cookies, so no consent
banner is needed, and over Cloudflare because the data stays with an EU
company on EU infrastructure, with no third-country transfer to explain.
To switch tools, change these fields: the privacy pages and the policy
follow from them. Facts above are from plausible.io/privacy, read 2026-11-16.
